question: On the maternal side, the Mughals were descendants of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Genghis Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On the **maternal side**, the Mughals were descendants of **Genghis Khan**.
 
• **Genghis Khan**, originally named **Temujin**, was the founder of the **Mongol Empire**, which became the largest contiguous empire in history.
 
• He was born in the year **1162** and established the Mongol Empire by uniting the **nomadic tribes** of Northeast Asia.
 
• The Mughal dynasty in India traced its lineage to him through their founder, **Babur**, whose mother was a descendant of Genghis Khan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tajuddin Yalduz**__

 __
 
• **Tajuddin Yalduz** was a ruler of the **Ghurid Empire** in the 13th century.
 
• He was not directly related to the Mughal lineage.
 
 
 
• **Timur**__
 __
 
• **Timur**, also known as **Tamerlane**, was a 14th-century conqueror and the founder of the **Timurid Empire** in Persia and Central Asia.
 
• On the paternal side, the Mughals were descendants of Timur.
 
 
 
• **Mohammad Ghori**__
 
 
• **Muhammad Ghori** was a ruler of the **Ghurid Empire** who invaded India in the late 12th century.
 
• He played a crucial role in establishing Islamic rule in the Indian subcontinent but was not directly related to the Mughal dynasty.
